# Verified results for the Phase 1-3 exploratory ablations (auto-generated by analysis/phase23.py)

All numbers below are computed from the verdict records in harness/results-abl, harness/results-p2, harness/results-p2screen and harness/results-p3 and the arm metadata in harness/abl-*/ and harness/ablr-*/contexts.json. Paired contrasts use the instance-level percentile bootstrap (2,000 resamples, seed 2): mean difference, two-sided 95% interval, one-sided 95% lower bound (the preregistered decision bound), sign counts (+/−/0), n instances. ε = 0.05.

## Phase 3 (2026-10-13/14): declaration-level arms and matched padding on the 11 instances selected by the k=20 W/A1 screen (either rate in [0.1, 0.9]); hugo instance selected but dropped (unrunnable)

Screen: 35 instances screened with W and A1 at k=20 on Haiku 5.5; 12 selected including gohugoio/hugo c9f6e4d4abc3, which was dropped on 2026-10-14 (its single instance produced a 182 GB build cache); 11 run (8 cli, 3 caddy). Haiku 5.5 k=50 on W, A1, A1t, Wd, A1r, Wdr, Wpad (W and A1 continue the k=20 screen samples); Sonnet 5.5 k=10 on W, A1, Wd, A1r, Wdr, Wpad. 17 records written while the disk was full on 2026-10-14 were purged with their cached-verdict dependants and re-sampled.

Arms: Wd = declarations of W reachable through the type-checked reference graph from identifiers in the fail-to-pass tests and task-text code spans/selectors (imports and package clauses kept, omitted declarations marked); A1r = full W plus only the dependency declarations W references, rendered without bodies; Wdr = the slice plus the dependency declarations the slice references; Wpad = W preceded by inert same-module padding (pilot pool) matched to A1's prompt tokens.

Mining windows: commits since 2026-06-01; caddy 159 first-parent commits, hugo 240, zap 13 (none valid); relaxed limits (≤4 packages, ≤300 changed lines) on restic and golangci-lint on 2026-10-14 produced no new valid instance; relaxed mining of caddy, hugo and cli was stopped by the disk incident and not rerun.
